scope: Technical GPX availability and official route-version review for top-level events 51–60
safetyRules: Existing GPX files remain valid until an official replacement is actually downloaded, parsed and validated.
No GPX files were deleted, overwritten or replaced.
An interactive map or GPX button does not count as a validated local GPX file.
Historic tracks remain historical and must not be represented as current 2027 courses.
